name: io.github.JonathanRReed/apple-mcp-notes
title: Apple Notes
description: Inspect, search, create, edit, move, and organize notes in Apple Notes on macOS.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safety mode for Notes operations: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_MCP_ALLOWED_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of Notes account names. Empty allows all accounts.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NOTES_MCP_ALLOWED_FOLDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of Notes folder names. Empty allows all folders.
